## English

### Improvements
- Integrated the device summary into the title area, removing the empty strip above the workspace.
- Refined macOS window-button spacing and reserved space for Windows window controls so long device names remain clear.

### Fixes
- Fixed a blank toolbar covering the device title in macOS full-screen mode.
- Restored the native window-button layout when leaving full screen and extended window dragging to the device icon.

## 简体中文

### 改进
- 将设备摘要融入标题区域，去掉工作区顶部的空白横条。
- 优化 macOS 窗口按钮的间距，为 Windows 窗口按钮预留空间，避免遮挡较长的设备名称。

### 修复
- 修复 macOS 全屏时空白工具栏遮挡设备标题的问题。
- 退出全屏后恢复原生窗口按钮布局，并支持从设备图标区域拖动窗口。
